epistemicLaw: Infinite scientific curiosity. Finite, verifiable engineering increments. Research proxies strictly decoupled from patient clinical truth.

studies.title: NEO Epidural Brain–Computer Interface & Constrained Motor Intention Research Module
studies.primaryPrecedent: NEO Implanted BCI System (Tsinghua University / Neuracle Medical)
studies.targetTissueOrOrgan: Primary Motor Cortex (M1) Hand Knob & Cervical Spinal Cord
studies.speciesOrPopulation: Adults with severe cervical spinal-cord injury (subaxial C4-C7)
studies.licenseAndProvenance: NMPA Class III Innovation Approval (March 2026); Huashan Hospital clinical evaluation
studies.scientificQuestion: Can minimally invasive epidural sensorimotor high-gamma ECoG reliably decode upper-limb motor intentions in chronic cervical spinal-cord injury without cortical tissue penetration?
studies.falsifiableHypothesis: Wireless epidural ECoG recordings over precentral gyrus yield >=80% multi-class motor intention accuracy during attempted hand grasp/open while preserving 12-month signal stability.

studies.title: HiCM-188 Human iPSC-Derived Cardiomyocyte Regeneration & REVIVE-HEART Trial Outcomes Engine
studies.researchDomain: Cardiovascular Regenerative Medicine & Stem Cell Therapy
studies.targetTissueOrOrgan: Left Ventricular Myocardium (Ischemic Scar / Border Zone)
studies.speciesOrPopulation: Adults with ischemic cardiomyopathy and advanced heart failure (NYHA III/IV, LVEF <=35%)
studies.licenseAndProvenance: ClinicalTrials.gov registry NCT07496372; Phase III multicenter randomized controlled protocol
studies.scientificQuestion: Does epicardial intramyocardial injection of purified hiPSC-CMs (HiCM-188) during CABG improve functional exercise capacity and LV remodeling compared to CABG alone?
studies.falsifiableHypothesis: Addition of HiCM-188 to standard CABG improves Delta 6MWD at 12 months by a between-group contrast of >=30 meters compared to CABG alone.

studies.title: FOXO3-Engineered Senescence-Resistant hMPCs & Primate Longevity Mechanism Atlas
studies.primaryPrecedent: Lei et al., Cell 2025 (Senescence-resistant human mesenchymal progenitor cells in aged macaques)
studies.targetTissueOrOrgan: Systemic Vascular Endothelium, Bone Marrow, Liver & Skeletal Muscle Niches
studies.speciesOrPopulation: Aged Cynomolgus Macaques (Macaca fascicularis, ~18-22 years old)
studies.licenseAndProvenance: Cell (Elsevier) Open Access / PMID 40516525; CAS Institute of Zoology preclinical program
studies.scientificQuestion: Can systemic infusion of genetically enhanced SR-hMPCs attenuate tissue inflammaging and restore multi-organ regenerative capacity in aged non-human primates over 44 weeks?
studies.falsifiableHypothesis: FOXO3-enhanced hMPCs resist oxidative stress senescence, suppress circulating SASP biomarkers by >=25%, and reduce multi-tissue epigenetic age in aged macaques without neoplasia.

studies.title: ACSL4-Mediated Ferro-Aging Molecular Mechanism & Erratum-Corrected Evidence Model
studies.primaryPrecedent: Liu et al., Cell Metabolism 2026 (An iron-lipid aging pathway involving ACSL4 in primates)
studies.researchDomain: Molecular Longevity, Iron Homeostasis & Lipid Peroxidation
studies.targetTissueOrOrgan: Hepatic Parenchyma, Renal Proximal Tubules & Vascular Endothelium
studies.speciesOrPopulation: Aged Cynomolgus Macaques (long-term dietary vitamin C intervention cohort)
studies.licenseAndProvenance: Cell Metabolism (Elsevier) 2026; incorporates published erratum doi:10.1016/j.cmet.2026.08.011
studies.scientificQuestion: How does age-dependent labile iron accumulation couple with ACSL4-driven phospholipid peroxidation, and can redox modulation attenuate this cascade without impairing physiological ferroptosis?
studies.falsifiableHypothesis: Age-associated labile iron increase synergizes with ACSL4-mediated PE-PUFA enrichment, driving chronic lipid hydroperoxides mitigated by sustained redox co-factors.

errata.description: Correction to Fig 3/5: LC-MS/MS peak integration standards for PE-18:0/20:4-OOH and fluorometric LIP calibration coefficients.
errata.parameterImpact: Adjusted k_ACSL4 esterification rate multiplier from 3.42 to 1.63; corrected baseline labile Fe2+ in aged liver from 18.2 uM to 9.4 uM.

studies.title: Multi-Modal Biological Aging Clocks & Clinical Biomarker Validation Engine
studies.primaryPrecedent: Clinical Trial NCT06794255 (Oral Vitamin C and Human Aging Biomarkers Investigation)
studies.targetTissueOrOrgan: Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMCs) & Plasma Metabolome
studies.speciesOrPopulation: Human adult volunteers (cohort aged 40-75 years in randomized double-blind evaluation)
studies.licenseAndProvenance: ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT06794255; Human Aging Biomarker Protocol
studies.scientificQuestion: Does nutritional redox intervention produce statistically significant, reproducible alterations in 2nd- and 3rd-generation epigenetic clocks (GrimAge, DunedinPACE) in middle-aged and older adults?
studies.falsifiableHypothesis: Longitudinal administration of oral vitamin C over 12 months produces measurable slowing in pace of biological aging (DunedinPACE reduction >=0.05 years/year).

studies.title: Chinese Immune Multi-Omics Atlas (CIMA) & Immunosenescence Regulatory Knowledge Layer
studies.primaryPrecedent: CIMA Consortium, Science 2026 (Single-cell multi-omic atlas of human immune system across adult lifespan)
studies.targetTissueOrOrgan: Peripheral Blood Immune System (PBMCs, 58 discrete immune subsets)
studies.speciesOrPopulation: 428 healthy Chinese adults stratified across 7 decades (ages 20 to 89 years)
studies.licenseAndProvenance: Science (AAAS) 2026; National Genomics Data Center (NGDC) HRA009968. Summary statistics open; raw individual sequencing under DAC governance.
studies.scientificQuestion: What are the cell-type-specific transcriptomic, chromatin-accessibility, and eQTL/caQTL landscapes that characterize healthy human immune aging across the adult lifespan in an Asian population?
studies.falsifiableHypothesis: Age-dependent immune remodeling is driven by cell-type-specific chromatin closures in naive T-cell enhancers alongside selective expansion of cytotoxic CD4+ CTLs and CD8+ TEMRA with inflammatory networks.

studies.title: Human Ensemble Cell Atlas (hECA v2.0) Whole-Body Multiscale Reference Adapter
studies.primaryPrecedent: hECA v2.0 Consortium, Scientific Data (XuegongLab, Tsinghua University)
studies.researchDomain: Whole-Body Systems Biology & Multiscale Single-Cell Atlases
studies.targetTissueOrOrgan: Whole Human Body: 11 Organ Systems, 42 Distinct Organs and Tissues
studies.speciesOrPopulation: Human donor consensus ensemble (>10.83M scRNA profiles, >1.45M scATAC profiles)
studies.datasetAccession: hECA v2.0 Data Portal & GitHub XuegongLab/hECA-v2.0
studies.licenseAndProvenance: Nature Scientific Data / CC BY 4.0 Open Access; Unified cell identity harmonization across international consortia
studies.scientificQuestion: How can 10.83 million single-cell RNA and 1.45 million single-cell ATAC profiles from 42 human organs be hierarchically structured into a unified multiscale representation?
studies.falsifiableHypothesis: An ensemble graph architecture incorporating Cell Ontology (CL) harmonization and batch-corrected consensus embeddings reliably maps single-cell identity across 42 organs with >95% cross-tissue consistency.
